test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A sum of money becomes Rs.10648 after 3 years and Rs.9680 after 2 years of compound interest computed yearly. What is the rate of interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Amount after 3 years at compound interest = Rs.10648

Amount after 2 years at compound interest = Rs.9680 

**Formula used:**

Rate = (Interest × 100)/Principal × Time 

**Calculation:**

Rs.9680 becomes Rs.10648 in one year

⇒ (10648 - 9680) = Interest on Rs.9680 

⇒ 968 = Interest on Rs.9680

**∴ Rate = (968 × 100)/9680 × 1 = 10%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**P(1 + r/100)³/P(1 + r/100)² = 10648/9680

⇒ 1 + r/100 = 10648/9680

⇒ r/100 = (10648 - 9680)/9680

⇒ r/100 = 968/9680

⇒ r = 10%
